Overview.Name: Thanneeru Rakesh
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) (pan-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Option 3: Curd rice (small bowl cooked rice & curd & salt)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (pressure-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (simple) & curd (small cup)
Option 3: Cooked rice (smaller portion) & paneer curry (pan-cooked)
Meal_3: Option 1: Fish curry (simple) & small bowl cooked rice
Option 3: Clear soup (veg, no cauliflower) & buttermilk (unsweetened)

Notes_and_Tips: For diabetes: keep rice portions consistent (about 1 cup cooked ~150 g) and avoid juices and sugary snacks.
For hypertension: limit salty fried foods and keep home-cooked simple curries most days.
For thyroid: if on thyroid tablets, keep milk/curd and calcium/iron supplements 3–4 hours away (as per doctor advice).
Stress eating: do 5 minutes slow breathing before dinner to reduce cravings.
Bedtime (optional): warm turmeric milk (small cup, no sugar) or warm water.
SIMS / nutrition theory note: protein-first meals and steady timing support stable energy and better control.
